question: Will SpaceX conduct 10 or more Starship launch attempts in 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if SpaceX conducts 10 or more Starship (Super Heavy + Ship integrated vehicle) launch attempts between January 1, 2026 00:00 UTC and December 31, 2026 23:59 UTC, as documented in the Wikipedia – List of Starship launches or SpaceX Official Website.
- "No": Wins if the total number of Starship launch attempts within the same calendar-year 2026 window is fewer than 10.

Clarifications:
- A launch attempt is defined as an integrated Starship vehicle (Super Heavy booster + Ship upper stage) that lifts off the pad; static fires, ground tests, and on-pad aborts before liftoff do not count. Outcome of the upper stage or payload delivery does not affect whether the launch attempt counts.
